notes.title: #17 Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
Hello,
Today I'm here to announce the hotfix.

The game has been updated for few bugs below:

    Solved compatibility problem between controllers and few NPCs' conversation.


* For Linux Users : If you have a problem that the game's screen is not in center for full-screen mode. Just change the current screen mode to the window mode and rechange it to the full-screen mode. You may see the game's screen will be in center correctly.

If you have any reports, please use email or the game's community forum.
I'm always checking both of them.
Have a nice day.
- xPathfinder

notes.title: Next Patch for Mac OS X users.
notes.notes:
Hello,
I'm xPathfinder who's the developer of 'Ace of Protectors'.

Today, I'm going to announce new future patch for Mac OS X users.
Please mind this patch announcement is only for Mac OS X. So, if your operating system is not Mac, you are good to skip this announcement.

After the release of 'El Captian', the Keychain System was changed a little bit. So, this made compatibility problem with the game. That's why users using 'El Captian' or later versions are having crashes.
(If you're using any older versions like Yosemite, you may not have problem with this.)

However, I have a solution for this. I'll fix this compatibility probem as soon as possible. It might take 2 or 3 days to finish. I'll announce again when the patch's available.

Much thanks,
xPathfinder
